scope: Twelve original desktop still frames at 1280x720; visible scene framing, passport, footer, text and representation boundaries only

build.imageAssociation: 068c capture filenames and parent capture-session assignment; visible pixels do not independently expose runtime build ID. No browser identity was re-read during this review.

issues.description: Restore observation control overlaps the right side of the passport explanation paragraph below the temperature/luminosity/radius row, obscuring words in the parametric representation disclaimer in all twelve screenshots.
issues.coordinateMethod: Visual estimate in original 1280x720 pixels; not a DOM hit-test or measured layout rectangle.
issues.recommendation: Place observer restore control outside the open passport content, then inspect revised-build evidence. Preserve these failure images.

issues.description: Discrete bright points lie visibly over the selected disk; approximate locations and bounded interpretation recorded per row.
issues.recommendation: Inspect rendering/depth ownership before assigning a cause. Do not treat the specks as validated scientific surface features.

artifactNotes.description: All original files have .png extension but actual JPEG signature ffd8ffe000104a46 and sharp format jpeg. Original bytes preserved; no rename/transcode performed.
artifactNotes.recommendation: Record actual media type and use matching extension for future captures. This naming issue alone does not invalidate visible pixels or content hashes.

limitations: UI roundtrip/lifecycle passes were not used as a premise for visual acceptance.
Stills cannot establish animation stability, hit targeting, interaction success, all scroll positions, renderer frame time, memory behavior or resource release.
No mobile image was inspected in this task and no physical-device claim is made.
Illustrative parametric appearance is not an observed resolved surface or independent validation of astrophysical values.
Original failure images remain unchanged; findings need retesting on revised production builds.
